I see! So the issue is clear:
- March 28 is Thursday
- March 29 is Friday (a holiday)
- The algorithm counts March 29 as a business day (because it only checks weekday, not holidays)
- Then counts April 1 (Monday) as the 2nd business day
- Returns April 1

But it should:
- March 28 is Thursday
- Skip March 29 (holiday)
- Skip March 30-31 (weekend)
- Count April 1 (Monday) as the 1st business day
- Count April 2 (Tuesday) as the 2nd business day
- Return April 2
